sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of aminexil during breastfeeding. Maternal use of topical aminexil should pose low risk to older, full-term breastfed infants, but might best be avoided while breastfeeding a preterm or neonatal infant.
